originality.rationale: Primary OA full-text comparison found no exact all-size cycle edge-GP enumerator or maximal-set spectrum. Strongest reducibility risk—general d-position sets on cycles at d=floor(n/2)-1—is explicitly compared with 2020 Proposition 3.3 and Theorem 4.1; these establish maxima and an abstract characterization but do not give exact n-dependent counting coefficients, maximal cardinality spectrum or purity exception. Targeted published-record queries returned closest edge-GP enumerator on spider trees, not a cycle equivalence. Priority remains probabilistic, not a uniqueness proof.
